title: Colonial Gas Company submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with Baker Commodities, Inc.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judity F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Soo J. Kim. (DTE-06-GC-27)
